WITH per_scan AS (
  SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin AS gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0
),
per_operator AS (
  SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM per_scan
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM per_operator
)
SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS average_scan_count,
       AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS average_gb_per_min,
       AVG(avg_gb_per_min - all_operator_avg.avg_gb_per_min) AS average_margin_above_all_operator_average
FROM per_operator
CROSS JOIN all_operator_avg
WHERE per_operator.avg_gb_per_min > all_operator_avg.avg_gb_per_min
